summary.intent: Assess whether the performance work (#506, #508, #509) improved speed without hurting quality, determine whether Codex made changes to the codebase, and evaluate and land Codex's diagnostics fix (file -> files: [probe]).
summary.outcome: Gave an honest verification assessment, found Codex only left setup files and Entire session records and no authored commits, then re-applied Codex's uncommitted probe-diagnostics patch in a clean worktree, passed lint, 1,702 tests and a mutation proof, and committed it locally without pushing (commit completion was being checked).

repo: Codex used in this repo leaves no author, trailer, branch or PR; changes would be committed under the user's git identity, so authorship cannot reveal them. Entire session records are the only trace.
Codex/Gemini/Cursor/Copilot/OpenCode hook and skill mirror files (.codex/hooks.json, .gemini/settings.json) were added by the user's own commits and are setup files, not product code.
Checker's timeout fallback makes some runs differ from themselves under load, which muddies output-identity checks; degraded runs should be rejected, not just rerun.
With collapse off, spectrum's private-field name carries a checker id that shifts when request counts change (pre-existing bug that surfaces as an output difference).
Gates per PR: lint, doc-check, machete, typos, tests; weekly oracle accuracy run costs money and is limited to once per batch.
Timing measurements on this machine (load 20-60) are noisy; counts and CPU are steadier than wall time.

code.finding: The diagnostics request should send files: [probe] instead of the singular file; with the singular form the response returns another file's error. A new regression test fails when reverted. Exact lines were not given in the transcript.

workflow: Run the mutation proof (revert the fix, confirm the new test fails) before trusting a regression test.

An Edit whose old string matches multiple places can restore the wrong spot; after a restore, verify by diffing against the original patch before running gates, since the earlier lane run was invalid.
Applying another agent's uncommitted patch in a clean worktree off main isolates it from other in-flight work.
Use interleaved baseline vs patched binary comparisons with identity checks and degraded-run exclusion rather than sequential timings.
